title: The Hospital That X-Rayed 1,000 Pregnant Women for Skull Measurement
hook: In the 1950s, a hospital ran a 10-year experiment X-raying pregnant women to measure fetal skulls—without consent, and they knew the risks.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines vulnerable victims (pregnant women), secret experimentation, and long-term health horror—three pillars of viral dark content.

title: The $50 Billion Drug That Was Just Sugar Water with a Side Effect of Death
hook: A blockbuster arthritis drug earned $50 billion before they admitted it caused fatal blood clots in 1 in 10 patients.
why_this_can_go_viral: The shocking contrast of 'sugar water' versus 'death' triggers intense curiosity, especially with the massive dollar figure.

title: The Doctor Who Harvested 1,000 Eyes from Cadavers Without Permission
hook: An ophthalmologist ran a private 'eye bank' collecting corneas from dead bodies without consent—using them for transplants and selling the rest.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body horror plus corruption of trust—people are morbidly fascinated by the idea of their own or loved ones' bodies being exploited.

title: The FDA-Approved 'Anti-Aging' Injection That Filled Faces with Industrial Plastic
hook: Thousands paid for a 'bio-compatible' filler that turned out to be untreated industrial plastic—causing permanent deformation and infection.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vanity meets horror—women who paid for beauty got permanent mutilation. Strong emotional trigger and relatability.

title: The Suppressed Malaria Vaccine That Caused 100% Infection in Trial
hook: A 'breakthrough' malaria vaccine was tested on 2,000 children—every single child got malaria, and the trial was buried.
why_this_can_go_viral: '100% infection' is a statistically impossible horror that demands explanation—perfect for click-through.

title: The Dental Implant That Corroded Patients' Jawbones Into Powder
hook: A popular titanium dental implant had a hidden chemical flaw—it slowly dissolved jawbone, turning it into a calcium dust over months.
why_this_can_go_viral: Gross-out factor plus horror of losing your jawbone—visceral disgust and fear of common medical devices.

title: The Vitamin Company That Sold Crushed Cat Bones as 'Calcium Plus'
hook: A best-selling 'natural' calcium supplement was made from ground-up euthanized shelter animals—and nobody caught it for five years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme disgust factor and betrayal of trust—millions took it unknowingly. 'What's in your vitamins?' is a viral hook.

title: The Doctor Who Prescribed 4,000 Placebo Surgeries to Collect Insurance
hook: A surgeon performed fake operations—cutting patients open and closing them without doing anything—all to bill insurance.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shock of being cut open unnecessarily—pure medical horror with a financial crime twist. Extremely high curiosity gap.

title: The 'All-Natural' Sleep Pill That Was 100% Liquid Methamphetamine
hook: An FDA-registered 'herbal sleep aid' from a famous wellness brand was secretly pure meth—37 people died before it was pulled.
why_this_can_go_viral: The complete opposite of what you'd expect—sleep aid that's a stimulant. Irony and death toll make it shareable.

title: The Hospital That Deliberately Infected 2,000 Orphans with Syphilis for Research
hook: In the 1940s, a U.S. hospital injected orphaned children with syphilis to study the disease—and never treated them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme violation of the most vulnerable—orphans. Comparable to Tuskegee but worse. High outrage factor.

title: The Skin Cream That Gave Women 'Super Sweating' Disease for Life
hook: A popular acne cream destroyed sweat glands in 3,000 women—leaving them unable to cool down, permanently trapped in a fever state.
why_this_can_go_viral: Relatable fear (acne) leads to unimaginable lifelong damage. Female audience will share heavily.

title: The Clinical Trial That Gave Patients Liquid Metal Instead of a Vaccine
hook: A batch of trial vaccines was contaminated with liquid mercury—patients were injected with a heavy metal that never left their bodies.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual imagery of liquid metal in veins is deeply disturbing and memorable. Anti-vaccine audiences will amplify.

title: The Cancer 'Cure' That Was 100% Bleach—And Doctors Sold It to Terminals
hook: A network of clinics treated terminal cancer patients with industrial bleach injections, calling it 'oxidizing therapy'—hundreds died in agony.
why_this_can_go_viral: Desperate patients exploited with a household cleaner—heartbreaking and enraging. 'Bleach cancer cure' is a search magnet.

title: The Hospital That Put Patients in Induced Comas to Harvest Their Organs
hook: A transplant surgeon was found to have induced comas in healthy patients to 'harvest' their organs for wealthy recipients—eight confirmed cases.
why_this_can_go_viral: Highest darkness score—violates the fundamental trust of 'hospitals save lives.' Strong narrative of good vs evil.

title: The FDA-Approved Birth Control That Caused Blindness in 1 in 200 Users
hook: A popular 1960s birth control pill had a side effect so severe that 1 in 200 users went permanently blind—and the FDA kept it on shelves for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines reproductive rights anger with shocking side effect—highly shareable among female audiences.

title: The Clinical Trial That Pumped Fresh Cow Blood Into Human Lungs
hook: In the 1920s, a researcher tried to cure disease by pumping cow blood directly into a patient's lungs—they died within minutes.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visually grotesque and absurd—the absurdity makes it highly shareable as 'old medicine was crazy' content.

title: The Vitamin Company That Sold Radioactive Water as 'Health Tonic' for 30 Years
hook: A wellness brand sold radium-infused water as an 'energy tonic' to thousands—their jaws literally fell apart from bone cancer.
why_this_can_go_viral: 'Jaws falling apart' is nightmare fuel. Radium water is a well-known historical horror that still fascinates.

title: The Hospital That Wrapped Diabetic Wounds in Asbestos-Laced Bandages
hook: A hospital supply company sold asbestos-impregnated bandages for diabetic ulcers—patients died of mesothelioma instead of infection.
why_this_can_go_viral: Hidden danger in a common medical product—plays on fear that everyday hospital items could be poisoning you.

title: The 'Pain Doctor' Who Injected Patients with Used Motor Oil for Cash
hook: A pain management specialist injected 700 patients with recycled motor oil mixed with lidocaine—40 died of sepsis before he was caught.
why_this_can_go_viral: Extreme exploitation of pain patients—motor oil is shockingly cheap substitute. Outrage and disgust drive shares.

title: The Clinical Trial That Gave Patients Injections of Ground-Up Human Tumors
hook: A 1950s cancer trial injected patients with homogenized tumor tissue from other patients—to 'boost immunity'—it spread cancer instead.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cannibalistic medical horror—injecting tumor into a patient is a primal violation. High shock value.
